payload.name: Black Metaphors
payload.fact: Medieval black metaphors associated blackness with sinfulness and depravity, establishing a foundational concept of racial division.

provenance.title: Black Metaphors: How Modern Racism Emerged from Medieval Race-Thinking
provenance.quote_or_locus: it is in this time period, he notes, that contemporary concepts of race began to solidify, particularly the association of the term black with sinfulness and depravity
